title: Without Work Orders — Delete, Reopen is not shown
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed.
  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit' but not 'Work Orders — Delete', at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The document shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu does not offer "Reopen Work Order", as it would not offer "Reverse".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S4-N1: “If the user does not have 'Work Orders — Delete', Reopen is not shown.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions (Action | Needs | Without it): “Reopen Work Order | 'Work Orders — Delete' | Action hidden, as Reverse (S4-N1)”
